---

## INCIDENT REPORT

**Date:** 2024-11-26  
**Report ID:** MTA-2024-11-26-001

---

### EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Windows enterprise workstation **10.11.26.183** (DESKTOP-B8TQK49) is compromised with **NetSupport RAT** malware. The infected host established persistent command-and-control communication with remote infrastructure, exfiltrated system data, and attempted lateral movement within the network.

---

### INFECTED/VICTIM HOST

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **IPv4 Address** | 10.11.26.183 |
| **MAC Address** | d0:57:7b:ce:fc:8b |
| **Windows Hostname** | DESKTOP-B8TQK49 |
| **Logged-In User** | sSEg |
| **Host Role** | Windows workstation on 10.11.26.0/24 LAN |

---

### MALWARE IDENTIFICATION

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Malware Family** | NetSupport RAT |
| **Attribution Type** | Signature-confirmed (Suricata/ET Pro rules) |
| **Detection Signature** | ETPRO TROJAN NetSupport RAT CnC Activity |
| **Payload Mechanism** | User-Agent: NetSupport Manager/1.3 (HTTP POST over port 443) |

---

### COMMAND-AND-CONTROL INDICATORS

#### Primary C&C Infrastructure
| Type | Value | Port | Evidence |
|------|-------|------|----------|
| IP Address | 194.180.191.64 | 443 | Suricata alerts Events #4022, #4023, #4025 |
| C&C URL | http://194.180.191.64/fakeurl.htm | 443 | Repeated HTTP POST beacons, User-Agent: NetSupport Manager/1.3 |
| Protocol | HTTPS (malware-over-HTTPS) | 443 | Multiple POST requests at 08:50:45 UTC onwards |

#### Geolocation Lookup (NetSupport Infrastructure)
| Type | Value | Port | Evidence |
|------|-------|------|----------|
| URL | http://geo.netsupportsoftware.com/location/loca.asp | 80 | Suricata Alert #4026: NetSupport GeoLocation Lookup Request |
| IP Destination | 104.26.1.231 | 80 | Resolves to NetSupport geolocation service |

---

### MALICIOUS DOMAINS & ASSOCIATED INFRASTRUCTURE

| Domain | Purpose | IP Resolution | Evidence |
|--------|---------|---|----------|
| modandcrackedapk.com | ZPHP malware C&C | 193.42.38.139 | Suricata Alerts #3926 (DNS), #4018 (TLS SNI) |

**ZPHP Malware Indicators:**
- DNS query for modandcrackedapk.com from victim at 04:50:14 UTC (Alert #3926)
- TLS Client Hello with SNI=modandcrackedapk.com at 04:50:40 UTC to 193.42.38.139:443 (Alert #4018)
- Classification: ET CURRENT_EVENTS ZPHP Domain

---

### ANOMALOUS NETWORK ACTIVITY

#### Additional Suspicious Connections
| Destination | Port | Time | Alert Message |
|-------------|------|------|---|
| 104.117.247.184 | 80 | 04:49:38 UTC | ET INFO Terse Request for .txt - Likely Hostile |
| 4.149.227.78 | 443 | 04:49:41 UTC | ET POLICY TLSv1.0 Used in Session |

#### Internal Reconnaissance Activity
- **DCE-RPC Protocol Exploitation:** Victim queried Active Directory infrastructure (10.11.26.3) using EfsRpcOpenFileRaw (Encrypting File System Remote Protocol) at port 445 (Alert #3883)
- **SMBv1 Protocol Usage:** Unsafe SMB protocol engagement with DC at port 139 (Alerts #3914-#3918)
- **NTMLSSP Overflow Attempt:** GPL NETBIOS SMB Session Setup NTMLSSP unicode ASN.1 overflow detected (Alert #3915)
- **SMB Share Access:** IPC$ unicode share access to domain controller (Alert #3917)

---

### INDICATORS OF COMPROMISE (IOCs)

**User-Agent Strings:**
```
User-Agent: NetSupport Manager/1.3
```

**C&C Beacon Payload:**
- Command structure: `CMD=POLL`, `CMD=ENCD`, `ACK=1`, `INFO=1`
- Encoding: Hex-encoded form data, encrypted payloads with `ES=1` (encryption status)

**Unique Identifiers:**
- No SHA256 file hashes recovered (malware resident in memory or remotely hosted)
- No executable files detected in capture (possible fileless attack or lateral execution)

---

### ATTACK TIMELINE

| Time (UTC) | Event |
|------------|-------|
| 04:49:38 | Hostile .txt request to 104.117.247.184:80 |
| 04:49:41 | TLSv1.0 session to 4.149.227.78:443 |
| 04:49:55 | DCE-RPC EfsRpcOpenFileRaw to domain controller |
| 04:50:10 | SMBv1 exploitation attempts (NTMLSSP, IPC$ share access) |
| 04:50:14 | DNS lookup for modandcrackedapk.com (ZPHP) |
| 04:50:40 | TLS connection to modandcrackedapk.com (193.42.38.139:443) |
| 04:50:45 | NetSupport RAT C&C beacons to 194.180.191.64:443 (primary C&C) |
| 04:50:45 onwards | Continuous HTTP POST beacons at 60-second intervals |

---

### NETWORK CONTEXT

- **Local Broadcast Domain:** 10.11.26.0/24
- **Domain Controller:** 10.11.26.3 (NEMOTODES-DC.nemotoads.health)
- **Workgroup:** NEMOTODES
- **Attack Origin:** Ingress from internet-facing C&C (194.180.191.64, modandcrackedapk.com)
- **Exfiltration Path:** Outbound HTTPS to 194.180.191.64:443

---

### RECOMMENDATIONS

1. **Immediate:** Isolate 10.11.26.183 from the network; do not power down (preserve memory for forensics)
2. **Memory Acquisition:** Capture RAM dump for malware analysis and payload recovery
3. **Domain Compromise Assessment:** Review SMB/DCE-RPC activity logs on 10.11.26.3; assess for lateral movement or credential theft
4. **Indicator Hunting:** Block all outbound connections to 194.180.191.64, 193.42.38.139, and modandcrackedapk.com at the perimeter
5. **Credential Reset:** Force password reset for user sSEg and all domain accounts accessed from this workstation
6. **Threat Intelligence:** Report 194.180.191.64 and modandcrackedapk.com to ISP and threat intelligence platforms

---
